description: React component for a modal dialog that allows regenerating API keys, including form handling, API calls, and UI updates.

methods.name: calculateNewExpiryTime
methods.description: Calculates a new expiry time based on a duration string (e.g., '30s', '2h', '5d').

methods.name: handleRegenerateKey
methods.description: Handles the process of regenerating the key, including API call, updating state, and notifying parent component.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets state and closes the modal.
